title: repo-standards declaration
description: What a repository of each class is required to contain. The repository-to-class mapping is NOT here: it is declared once, in the repo-inventory declaration, because a mapping written in two files is a mapping that drifts. No secret and no token appears in this file.

_readme.description: Free text carried by the template. Ignored by the loader.

classes.description: One entry per class named in the repo-inventory declaration. A class with an empty requiredFiles list is a decision - 'this class requires no files' - rather than an omission, and the plan reports it as ok.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root, with forward slashes. No leading slash and no relative segment: the path becomes a URL segment, and the URL builder escapes the query rather than the path.

reason.description: Why this file is required. It is printed in the plan, so an approver reads the reason rather than only the path.
